# agentic-realtime

Live edits for people and agents on one document, with offline support.

Keywords: yjs,crdt,realtime,collaboration,presence,offline,agents,durable-objects,cloudflare,mcp.

- Worker: createSyncWorker({ authorize }) from "agentic-realtime/worker".
- Exports: the README "Exports" section lists every name of each entry point: the main entry, /sdk, /client, /browser, /worker and /firestore.
- Protocol: connect a Yjs client to /api/v1/docs/:id/ws.
- Authorship: the room logs which principal (id and kind) sent each run of text.
  Compaction keeps the log, and each named snapshot keeps a copy. The kind marks
  agent text as machine-made.
- Read it: blame() from "agentic-realtime/sdk", `agentic-realtime doc blame`,
  the doc_blame MCP tool, or GET /api/v1/docs/:id/attribution.
- Limits: the log keeps up to 4000 ranges by default (SYNC_ATTRIBUTION_MAX_RANGES,
  4 to 5000) and stays under about 1.5 MB. Older text then shows as unattributed.
  Export and erase, by the owner or the host, cover the log.
- Export: owners use `agentic-realtime doc export --doc <id>` or MCP doc_export.
  Both return a JSON array. Owners delete with CLI `doc delete --doc <id> --confirm <id>` or MCP `doc_delete` with matching `doc` and `confirm`.
  Never give an agent the host secret.
- Firebase: createFirestoreStorage({ projectId, docId, fetch, token }) from
  "agentic-realtime/firestore" stores a document in Firestore over REST, with no
  SDK. It implements the RoomStorage port, which the in-memory adapter also does.

Host operators set AGENTIC_SYNC_ADMIN_SECRET for CLI `admin export|delete|revoke|role`.
Use --doc, --confirm for delete, --principal for revoke/role, and --role with
owner|editor|commenter|viewer|null. Successful results print as JSON on stdout. Help and errors are plain text.
Each subcommand accepts --help.
MCP host tools require AGENTIC_SYNC_ENABLE_ADMIN=1: admin_export, admin_delete,
admin_revoke, admin_role. Schemas use doc, confirm, principalId, role.
Only use this mode in a trusted host operator session. Credentials stay in the
server environment. The Worker checks authority. Never give an agent the host secret.
SDK createDocumentClient({ server, token }) and createAdminClient({ server, secret })
provide typed methods for the same routes. null lifts a role cap or revoke.
